packageRules.description: Supply chain: a new version waits 3 days before it is proposed (most compromised releases are pulled within hours). Same rule as cervio-devkit.
Lint toolchain moves together (was the Dependabot eslint-stack group).
Test toolchain moves together (was the Dependabot test-stack group).
@n8n/eslint-plugin-community-nodes peers eslint 9: no eslint 10 until the plugin supports it.
typescript-eslint 8.x requires typescript < 6.1: stay on 5.x until the lint stack catches up.
CI and publish run on Node 22: keep the types on 22 so the node never uses newer APIs.
The Node version in CI and publish follows the n8n runtime, changed by hand.
